mapper.sql: id, incident_id, plan_code, action_type, target_type, target_id, target_name, risk_level, status, summary, expected_effect, rollback_plan_json, before_json, after_json, confirmation_code, expires_at, created_by, approved_by, approved_at, executed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ops_action_plans ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ops_action_plans ( incident_id, plan_code, action_type, target_type, target_id, target_name, risk_level, status, summary, expected_effect, rollback_plan_json, before_json, confirmation_code, expires_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{incidentId}, #{planCode}, #{actionType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{riskLevel}, #{status}, #{summary}, #{expectedEffect}, #{rollbackPlanJson}, #{beforeJson}, #{confirmationCode}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdBy}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ops_action_plans SET status = 'EXECUTED', before_json = COALESCE(#{beforeJson}, before_json), after_json = #{afterJson}, executed_at = #{executedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'EXECUTING'
